claim: A busy Hub can take more than 2–3 seconds to answer /health on this machine, so stop or close logic must not treat a timeout as absence and must never delete a PID file because of a timeout.

citations.quote: On this machine, a busy Hub can take more than 2–3 s to answer /health.
Any stop or close logic must not treat a timeout as absence, and must never delete a PID file because of one.
